title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
About Zelis
  
  
At Zelis, we're modernizing the healthcare financial experience for all. Our connected platform simplifies complex healthcare financial interactions through innovative technology that connects payers, providers, and healthcare consumers.
  
  
**About The ZEDI Marketing Squad**
The ZEDI Marketing Squad is a dedicated, India-based software engineering squad within Information Technology that partners closely with Marketing to own, enhance, and evolve Zelis.com and supporting digital experience platforms. As a long-lived product team, the squad provides ongoing application development, platform support, analytics enablement, performance optimization, and release management while leading the organization's migration from WordPress to the Optimizely Digital Experience Platform (DXP) in 2027. The squad works daily with Marketing, UX, Product Management, Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and external implementation partners to deliver secure, scalable, and best-in-class digital experiences.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Senior Front End Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the presentation layer of Zelis.com and future digital experience platforms. This role focuses on delivering high-quality, performant, and accessible user experiences while partnering closely with UX designers, platform engineers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders. As a key member of the ZEDI Marketing Squad, this engineer will help establish reusable front-end architecture, evolve the enterprise design system, support analytics implementations, and play a significant role in the migration to Optimizely DXP. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for creating intuitive, accessible, and scalable web experiences.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop responsive, reusable, and maintainable front-end components using modern JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Implement user interfaces from Figma designs while maintaining consistency with the enterprise design system.
* Develop and maintain CMS templates, rendering logic, and authoring experiences within WordPress and future Optimizely DXP environments.
* Partner with UX designers to ensure experiences meet usability, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), and responsive design standards.
* Optimize Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse scores, and front-end performance.
* Implement technical SEO best practices and structured data where appropriate.
* Support Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and data layer implementations in partnership with Analytics teams.
* Implement cookie consent and privacy management solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers, QA Engineers, and the Technical Lead to deliver high-quality releases.
* Perform front-end debugging, testing, code reviews, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to the planning and execution of the 2027 Optimizely DXP migration.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6–10 years of professional front-end engineering experience building enterprise websites or digital platforms.
* Strong experience with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development.
* Experience working with enterprise CMS platforms; WordPress required, Optimizely preferred.
* Experience working in Agile software development teams.
* Strong understanding of accessibility, web performance, and modern UX implementation practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting large-scale CMS migrations or website redesigns.
* Experience with component libraries and design systems (Storybook or similar).
* Knowledge of Google Tag Manager, GA4, technical SEO, and analytics implementations.
* Experience in healthcare, SaaS, or other enterprise B2B environments.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or Figma Make.

Technical Skills
  
  

* JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3
* Responsive Design
* Component-driven architecture
* Figma
* WordPress CMS
* Optimizely CMS/DXP (preferred)
* Storybook or similar component libraries
* Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps
* Google Tag Manager & Google Analytics
* Technical SEO
* Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
* Core Web Vitals & Lighthouse
* Cross-browser compatibility

Professional Competencies
  
  
Excellent communication and collaboration skills; attention to detail; strong problem-solving ability; customer-first mindset; ability to balance multiple priorities; continuous learning mindset; experience working effectively across global teams.
  
  
What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months
  
  

* Become a trusted engineering partner to Marketing and UX.
* Improve website performance, accessibility, and component reuse.
* Establish scalable front-end patterns supporting the Optimizely DXP migration.
* Contribute to predictable Agile delivery and high-quality production releases.
* Help mature the enterprise design system and front-end engineering standards.

Our IMPACT Values
  
  

* Drive Innovation
* Embrace a Growth Mindset
* Put People First
* Act with Agility
* Champion Collaboration
* Build Trust

Workplace Flexibility
  
  
This position is based in India and operates remotely while collaborating closely with global teams across India and the United States.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

Provide 24x7 on-call support periodically throughout the year.Work with third party vendors to develop software and/or integrate their software into our products Required Skills/KnowledgeStrong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, CSS, and RTL or Cypress.Hands-on experience using at least one AI coding assistant (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as part of regular development workflow.Familiarity with AI-native concepts—RAG patterns, vector databases, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and agent orchestration—and how they differ from traditional architecture.Analyze production defects, troubleshoot systems, identify root cause, and implement fixes Experience with unit testing frameworks, UI test cases in a Test-driven development (TDD) environment Working Experience with Micro Frontend Architecture. We are looking for an experienced
**Full Stack Engineer**
with 5–8 years of software development experience and strong hands-on expertise in
**Python, Django, ORM, React, AWS, Docker, and relational databases**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be a strong full-stack engineer who can design, build, deploy, and support scalable applications end-to-end. In addition to the core technology stack, we are looking for someone who is

* Build and manage containerized applications using Docker.
* Explore and implement AI-powered solutions, including AI agents and workflow automation.

Candidates
**must have hands-on experience**
with:

* React
* AWS
* Docker
* PostgreSQL and/or MySQL
* RESTful API development and integration
* SQL and relational database concepts

* Experience deploying and supporting applications in AWS environments.
* Experience with Docker and containerized application development.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and automated deployment practices.

Database Requirements
  
  

* Strong experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL.
* Strong understanding of relational database concepts.
* Experience with schema/data model design, joins, indexes, transactions, and query optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience accessing and managing relational data using ORM.
* Ability to troubleshoot database and ORM-related performance issues.

AI & Automation – Good to Have
  
  
Experience or strong interest in applying
**AI/Generative AI**
to real-world engineering and business problems is highly desirable.

* Building applications or features using LLMs / Generative AI.

* Automating engineering, operational, or business workflows using AI.

title: Engineer 4, Software Development & Engineering
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
This job involves designing and customizing new software applications to enhance functionality and user experience. It includes managing software updates and releases, and working with stakeholders to develop solutions that meet business needs. It mentors junior staff, manages technical documentation, and uses performance metrics to improve software reliability. Collaboration with Quality Assurance ensures compliance with technical specifications. The role also requires management of documentation, analysis of market trends, and participating/leading in collaborative development sessions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Designing new software applications, analyzing system requirements and customizing applications to maximize functionality and user experience
* Assisting in the software update and release process, ensuring seamless roll-outs of new features
* Collaborating with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to identify requirements and integrate tailored software solutions
* Providing mentorship to junior engineers, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and collaborative knowledge sharing
* Managing the documentation process for all development activities, ensuring clear and accessible information for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Tracking and evaluating software performance metrics, using data to inform decisions and enhance system reliability and user satisfaction
* Partnering with Quality Assurance to confirm that software complies with technical specifications, ensuring the delivery of reliable applications
* Leveraging market research and industry trends to drive project strategies and improve software products
* Participating in or leading peer programming sessions, design sprints, or prototyping sessions
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

title: Princ Engr-Software Devt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
This role requires a visionary technology leader who will champion the integration of Generative AI technologies into our projects. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise to drive innovation, enhance product offerings, and create efficient solutions that align with our strategic goals.
  
  

* AI Architecture, Agentic Systems & MLOps
* Agentic Workflows & Digital Workers: Design and operationalize GenAI-powered agents, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks that function as digital workers—automating complex decision-making for CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), ordering, orchestration, inventory, and service assurance.
* Process Mapping & Platform Integration: Analyze enterprise workflows to define operational logic, boundary conditions, and guardrails for agents deployed on the AI platform, ensuring high reusability and fast speed-to-value.
* Foundation Model Management: Integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source via Hugging Face/vLLM) while managing model routing, latency budgets, token cost optimization, and semantic caching.
* LLMOps & Governance: Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines featuring real-time model monitoring, fine-tuning, safety guardrails, automated CI/CD deployments, and evaluation pipelines (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix) to guarantee output quality, security, and compliance.
* Full Stack & Distributed Systems Architecture
* End-to-End Systems Engineering: Oversee the architectural blueprint for web applications, microservices, and event-driven asynchronous pipelines across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
* High-Performance Frontends: Architect dynamic, real-time user interfaces capable of streaming response handling (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and dynamic AI UI components. NodeJS, Angular is a must.
* API & Microservices Design: Build robust, highly concurrent, low-latency APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and microservice layers powering critical enterprise workflows.
* Cloud, Data Engineering & Analytics
* Multi-Cloud & Streaming Strategy: Build and scale data analytics and real-time streaming pipelines across cloud environments (AWS, GCP) to handle high-throughput customer, partner, and employee transactions.
* Data Persistence Models: Architect hybrid data persistence frameworks combining relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, DynamoDB), and high-precision vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Ingestion Pipelines: Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms.
* Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management
* Engineering Standards & Roadmaps: Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints.
* Delivery & Global Team Management: Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput.
* Validation & Iterative Review: Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs.
* Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
* Innovating

+ Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization.
+ Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions.
+ Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices

* Performance Monitoring and Improvement:

+ Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions.
+ Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency.
+ Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements.
+ Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization.
+ Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments.
+ Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
+ Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
+ Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
+ Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
+ Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
+ Delivering on the AGILE KPI’s and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience as an AI architect or similar role, with a focus on Generative AI
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and AI services.
* Software development experience in a diverse set of areas including scalable web applications
* Experience in Java/J2EE application development including experience leading a technical team in such web technologies.
* Experience in a DevOps software development environment.
* Experience migrating web applications to Cloud (AWS, Oracle Cloud or Cloud Foundry etc.)
* Knowledge and experience of Docker/Container technologies
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
* Ability to lead and inspire teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, and AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in computer science or computer engineering.
* Evaluate and choose appropriate technologies, design patterns, and algorithms for the development of robust and scalable software solutions
* Innovation mindset
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills ability to assimilate data from varied sources, apply deductive reasoning and scientific method, make inferences, draw testable conclusions, and resolve problems.
* Experience in virtualization and cloud platforms.
* Experience in building large scale systems-management, network monitoring systems, and monitoring applications.
* Ability to handle teams from multiple locations and working in an onshore/offshore model.
* Modify existing software to correct errors, to adapt it to new hardware, or to upgrade interfaces and improve performance.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

description:

**Job Description**

+ Integrate Alfresco with other applications using microservices architecture (Spring Boot), REST APIs, and Node.js services.
+ Build and maintain modern front-end components for Alfresco applications using Angular and JavaScript.
+ Integrate, configure, and optimize Apache Solr for advanced search capabilities within Alfresco solutions, ensuring fast and accurate content retrieval.

title: Global Senior Solution Engineer - SAP ABAP/FIORI
description:
**Position Purpose**
 The Solution Engineer for SAP ABAP/FIORI is responsible for designing and maintaining SAP applications and user interfaces within the SAP landscape. The role focuses on delivering high\-quality backend (ABAP) and frontend (Fiori/UI5\) solutions that enhance business processes and user experience.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on technical expertise with organizational responsibilities, ensuring efficient delivery, adherence to standards, and alignment with business and architectural requirements.
   

  

 The ABAP Global Senior Solution Engineer plays a key role in driving technical excellence, SAP system stability, mentoring team members, and collaborating closely with functional Solution Owners and Engineers as well as Architects.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to
   

  

* Design, develop, and govern SAP ABAP (OO ABAP, CDS Views, AMDP, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits) and FIORI development standards valid for current SAP landscape. Review and optimize data models and interfaces. Ensure high performance and efficient database usage (HANA\-optimized development).
* Support integration with other SAP and non\-SAP systems. Design and develop SAP Fiori applications using SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements.
* Extend standard Fiori apps and develop custom applications where required.
* Ensure responsive, intuitive, and user\-friendly UI/UX design. Work with OData services and gateway for frontend\-backend integration.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and solution designs.
* Collaborate with functional teams to ensure correct implementation of business logic. Contribute to architectural discussions and technical design decisions.
* Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices and enterprise standards. Contribute to analysis and resolution of incidents related to ABAP and Fiori applications. Allocate tasks, manage workload, and ensure efficient use of supplier team capacity. Provide hands\-on expertise in ABAP development (OO ABAP, CDS Views, AMDP, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits).
* Guide the team on best practices for clean code, reusability, and performance optimization. Lead complex technical developments and problem resolution.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience with ABAP programming (OO ABAP, CDS, debugging).
* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP ABAP development. Experience with SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development.
* Knowledge of OData services and SAP Gateway. Experience in S/4HANA environments (preferred).
* Understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI, SD, MM, BW) is a plus. Experience in SAP Fiori / UI5 development.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of business processes. Communication and collaboration skills.
* Quality and performance focus. Knowledge of SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* Fluent English required (oral and written).


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

  

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

 \#Sandoz
